svg.title: PRIME Hydration — Campaign Hero
svg.desc: A three-flavour campaign hero with swipe navigation and layered parallax, built in both vanilla JavaScript and Next.js. Highlights: Three flavours, swipe navigation, Layered parallax, Vanilla JS and Next.js builds. Built with Next.js · React · JavaScript. Live demo at https://suhailchalil.github.io/prime-hydration/.

g.text: A three-flavour campaign hero with swipe
